text:
alana: quick heads-up from a 10-min usability pass: when we canonicalize permalinks the breadcrumb briefly shows the pre-resolve path and the leftnav doesn't always reveal the active leaf. Keyboard users get disoriented.

mike: repro steps?

alana: 1) open external link to /orgs/foo/models/alias-bar/revisions 2) app redirects to /models/12345 (canonical) 3) breadcrumb flashes alias-bar then 12345; leftnav stays collapsed at Models.

sara: accessibility concern: that flash + missing nav focus breaks screen reader context. We should announce nav changes and set aria-current on the revealed node.

jess: UI idea: instead of instantly expanding the rail on redirect, defer a gentle reveal for ~120ms after router finish so we can render the final breadcrumb first and avoid the flicker. Show micro animation if prefers-reduced-motion is false.

tom: implementation plan: on router.beforeResolve, fetch alias->id mapping, call history.replaceState to canonicalize (no extra history entry), then on router:restored run reconcileNav(path) which expands ancestors, sets aria-current and focuses leaf with focus({preventScroll:true}). If node outside rail viewport, rail.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}).

nav-bot: Note: added Figma comment at https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/deferred-reveal (by @jess).

sara: for screen readers add an aria-live polite region: "Navigation: Models > alias-bar revealed". Also ensure focus ring is visible (not color-only) and element has role=link + tabindex=0.

mike: tests: unit for replaceState, aria-current toggle; e2e deep-link desktop/mobile; a11y smoke for live region text. Add perf guard to batch DOM writes when expanding multiple nodes to avoid layout thrash.

jess: copy tweak for breadcrumb: show resolved label (friendly alias) visually but use canonical id in the address bar. Add a subtle secondary label under breadcrumb showing id when they differ.

alana: consensus: canonicalize before mount where possible, reconcile nav after router restore, implement deferred reveal 100-200ms to avoid flicker, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and add aria-live announcement. Action items: eng (mike) implement + perf guards, a11y (sara) add live region & tests, design (jess) update Figma and tokens. I'll file issue #5233 and open the PR. :thumbsup:
